editorial.blurb: Guerrero's Pizza delivers honest, satisfying pizza and fries at reasonable prices—a reliable spot for a quick, delicious bite.
editorial.insiderTip: Order pizza slices if you're in a hurry; they're usually ready to go. If you want a full pizza, expect about 25 minutes and plan for leftovers—even a small feeds two.

topDishes.note: thick cheese, generous portions, reliably good
